consequence.statement: After the upgrade, external-secrets.io/v1alpha1 PushSecret resources with spec.template.engineVersion set to "v1" are rejected by the API server, so applies/updates of such resources fail validation until the field is set to an allowed value.
consequence.remediation: Change spec.template.engineVersion in any v1alpha1 PushSecret that still uses "v1" to a still-allowed value before or after upgrading; applies and updates of resources keeping "v1" will fail API server validation.

assertion.statement: In the external-secrets.io/v1alpha1 schema of pushsecrets.external-secrets.io, the value "v1" was removed from the allowed values of spec.template.engineVersion, and a resource using that removed value is rejected by the API server.
